entries.title: Firstmate's gestures now say what happened
entries.body: Every gesture Firstmate makes now comes with a few words, up to 40 characters, that tell you what you should know about what happened, such as "Sent the meter fix to a crewmate". The words show just above the character and fade after a few seconds. The app's own small reactions, such as the nod when your message is passed on to a crewmate, stay wordless. Words that arrive while a card covers the character still pass unseen.

picture.alt: The words Sent the meter fix to a crewmate above the Firstmate character
